jobs.description: Overview Jackson Nurse Professionals was recently awarded Best Places to work by the Orlando Business Journal. Apply now to join an awesome growing team! Jackson Nurse Professionals is a unique mix of highly skilled professionals who are passionate about putting Nurses to work while remaining incredibly supportive of each other. Our corporate culture encourages individual growth and team development through various training and team-building events while taking the time to have fun at annual potlucks, competitions, and company outings. Jackson Health Collective (JHC) is seeking an accomplished Senior Director of Business Development to drive enterprise growth across our healthcare staffing portfolio. This is a true new-business hunting role for a proven staffing sales leader who knows how to build pipeline, navigate complex enterprise buying environments, and close large-scale contracts. The primary focus will be developing net-new Managed Service Provider (MSP), health system, IDN, and enterprise staffing relationships with $1M+ annual contract value opportunities. You’ll represent the collective capabilities of JHC and its brand portfolio including JTP, LRS, JNP, JHP, and JPP to build strategic partnerships across nursing, allied health, rehabilitation, and other healthcare staffing categories. If you have a track record of opening doors at the Director, VP, SVP, and C-suite levels and turning complex opportunities into significant revenue, this role offers the opportunity to make a meaningful impact on JHC’s continued growth. What You’ll Own Build a High-Value Enterprise Pipeline Develop and execute a disciplined outbound strategy targeting large health systems, IDNs, MSP programs, and enterprise staffing opportunities. Generate net-new meetings through strategic prospecting, including calls, targeted email campaigns, LinkedIn/social selling, networking, referrals, and industry events. Identify and qualify opportunities with $1M+ in annual contract value (ACV). Build relationships with senior decision-makers and influencers across HR, Talent Acquisition, Workforce Strategy, Procurement, Supply Chain, and executive leadership. Own opportunities from initial outreach and discovery through negotiation and signed contract. Maintain strong CRM discipline, pipeline visibility, and accurate forecasting. Consistently achieve new-business revenue, pipeline, meeting, and activity goals. Leverage Your MSP & Staffing Expertise Bring a strong understanding of healthcare staffing, MSP programs, VMS platforms, enterprise procurement, and workforce solutions to client conversations. Navigate complex procurement and formal solicitation processes, including RFPs, RFIs, and RFQs, from identification through finalist presentations. Understand the competitive MSP landscape and identify opportunities to position JHC effectively against incumbent and competing staffing partners. Match client workforce challenges with capabilities across JHC’s multi-brand portfolio. Stay informed on healthcare staffing trends, market dynamics, competitive activity, and evolving workforce strategies. Lead Complex Deals from Opportunity to Close Lead consultative, multi-stakeholder sales processes for large, complex enterprise opportunities. Develop compelling business cases, proposals, and executive-level presentations tailored to each prospective client. Coordinate internal resources including executive leadership, proposal/bid support, operations, recruiting, account management, and legal. Lead commercial discussions and partner with senior leadership on contract negotiations. Navigate lengthy and complex buying cycles while maintaining momentum and executive engagement through close. Turn New Contracts into Successful Partnerships Partner closely with Account Management, Recruiting, and operational teams to ensure a seamless transition from signed agreement to implementation. Clearly communicate client expectations, credentialing requirements, program structures, and other critical information to delivery teams. Remain engaged during early account ramp-up to support a successful launch and establish a foundation for long-term growth. Identify opportunities for deeper penetration, additional orders, and expansion across JHC’s capabilities. How Success Will Be Measured Success in this role is centered on profitable new-business growth and the activities that create it, including: Net-new enterprise contracts won. Qualified pipeline generated and advanced. $1M+ ACV opportunities created and closed. New-client revenue and placements. Gross margin and gross profit performance. Penetration and expansion within targeted growth markets. Executive-level meetings and qualified opportunities generated. Pipeline health, forecast accuracy, and CRM discipline. Successful transition and activation of newly signed accounts. What You Bring 5+ years of business development or sales experience within the staffing industry, with demonstrated success closing large, complex contracts. Experience selling within the healthcare staffing industry strongly preferred. Demonstrated experience selling into and/or supporting MSP programs, including familiarity with VMS platforms, MSP structures, and procurement cycles. Proven history of pursuing and closing opportunities with $1M+ annual contract value. Experience building relationships and selling to Director, VP, SVP, and C-suite stakeholders. A demonstrated ability to self-generate pipeline through outbound business development, rather than relying primarily on inbound opportunities or an existing book of business. Experience navigating enterprise RFP/RFI/RFQ processes and complex procurement environments. Strong consultative selling, negotiation, and executive presentation skills. Strong understanding of the healthcare staffing landscape and the factors influencing health system workforce decisions. Experience with CRM platforms; Bullhorn experience is a plus. High school diploma or equivalent required; Bachelor’s degree preferred. Ability to meet E-Verify eligibility requirements. Willingness and ability to travel for client meetings, conferences, presentations, and industry events as needed. The Skills That Will Help You Thrive You’re a strategic seller who also enjoys the work of building something from the ground up. You’re comfortable opening doors, navigating ambiguity, engaging senior executives, and staying persistent through long enterprise sales cycles. You bring strong organization and time-management skills, executive-level communication, commercial judgment, and a disciplined approach to pipeline management. You’re competitive and results-driven while remaining collaborative, solutions-oriented, and committed to building relationships that last. Our Values At Jackson Health Collective, our approach to business is grounded in three core values: Others First — Put others before self. Wisdom — Do the wise thing. Growth — Keep getting better. These values guide how we work with our clients, our healthcare professionals, and one another. Work Schedule This is a full-time, hybrid position. Standard business hours are Monday through Friday, 8:30 a.m. to 5:30 p.m. Additional time outside standard business hours and travel may be required based on client and business needs. Ready to Build What’s Next? If you’re an experienced healthcare staffing sales professional who knows how to create enterprise pipeline, build relationships with senior decision-makers, navigate MSP environments, and close complex $1M+ opportunities, we want to hear from you. Join Jackson Health Collective and help shape the next stage of our enterprise growth. Position: Design Director
Role Overview
We are looking for an experienced Design Director to join the Haven team. The Design Director will take the core pillars from the Creative Director and articulate them into balanced, scalable, and engaging systemic loops.
You will own the structural blueprint of the game—ensuring that the player fantasy, narrative context and creative pillars translate beautifully into moment-to-moment gameplay, short-term loops, and long-term progression tracks. Additionally, you will hire, lead and organize a design team, mentoring designers to ensure the game vision and direction is executed at a AAA standard.
Reporting:
The Design Director will report directly to the
Creative Director
for the project.
Key Responsibilities
1. Design Direction & Vision Articulation
Translate the Vision:
Partner closely with the Creative Director to deconstruct abstract creative themes into clear, rationalized gameplay pillars and meta-structures.
Align Fantasy & Narrative:
Construct a comprehensive gameplay vision that weaves the game’s thematic fantasy and narrative context directly into cohesive mechanical elements.
Systemic Architecture:
Apply an innovative yet analytical approach to build robust moment-to-moment gameplay, short-term hooks, and long-term retention loops that perfectly suit the game's direction.
Establish Creative Constraints:
Define clear direction, intent, and structural boundaries for the design team, giving them a focused framework to maximize their creative freedom and innovation.
Design Review & Validation:
Establish high quality bars; review and validate all design work produced by the team to ensure mechanic solidity, balance, and alignment with the core vision.
2. Team Management & Studio Collaboration
Manage & Mentor:
Direct a team of game designers (Junior to Senior), conducting regular 1-on-1s, providing actionable performance feedback, and actively supporting their professional growth.
Cultivate Design Standards:
Maintain a structured, collaborative design environment that champions clear communication, objective analysis, and constructive criticism.
Cross-Discipline Alignment:
Act as the primary design ambassador for Engineering, UI/UX, Audio, and Live Operations, ensuring cross-functional clarity regarding design intent and vision.
Qualifications & Skills
Experience Required
AAA Track Record:
Minimum of 6+ years of experience in game design, with at least one shipped major AAA multiplayer title in a Senior, Lead, or Principal role.
Pre-Production & Lifecycle Experience:
Proven experience defining core loops during early conception and preparing complex systems for live-service stability.
People Management:
Minimum of 2+ years of direct experience managing, mentoring, and developing game designers.
Technical & Soft Skills
Innovative & Analytical Thinker:
A unique blend of out-of-the-box creative thinking and sharp analytical skills, capable of inventing fresh ideas and grounding them into logical, quantitative rules.
Vision Communication:
Exceptional verbal and written communication skills; an expert ability to articulate, argument, and pitch design concepts clearly to both the development team and studio leadership.
Live-Service & Multiplayer Literacy:
Deep experience navigating multiplayer architectural constraints, including matchmaking logic, playlist structures, anti-cheat considerations, and progression balancing within a live-service context (broadly applicable beyond traditional PvP frameworks).
Early Prototyping Comfort:
Ability to work lightly within a game editor to quickly validate and prototype design ideas during early conception phases.
Preferred Qualifications
Working knowledge of Unreal Engine.
A strong passion for gameplay innovation and a keen understanding of evolving trends in the global gaming market.
